from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"fuzz/fuzz-asn1.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":39,"var":"Data/Size","code":"feeder_init(Data, Size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes become the source buffer for all later parsing paths.","depends_on":[]},
  {"step":2,"file":"fuzz/fuzz-asn1.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":41,"var":"bytes_max","code":"bytes_max = (feeder_next_byte() << 8) + feeder_next_byte();","note":"The first two input bytes choose the allocated buffer length for the ASN.1 parser.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"input bytes"}]},
  {"step":3,"file":"fuzz/fuzz-asn1.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":47,"var":"bytes","code":"bytes = malloc(bytes_max);","note":"A heap buffer of attacker-selected size is allocated and then filled from the remaining input.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"bytes_max"}]},
  {"step":4,"file":"fuzz/fuzz-asn1.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":53,"var":"ret","code":"ret = feeder_next_byte() % 4;","note":"One input byte selects the execution path; the crash-relevant path is the ASN.1 validation branch.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"input byte"}]},
  {"step":5,"file":"fuzz/fuzz-asn1.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":56,"var":"ptls_asn1_validation(bytes, bytes_max, &ctx)","code":"ptls_asn1_validation(bytes, bytes_max, &ctx);","note":"The chosen heap buffer is handed to the recursive ASN.1 validator as untrusted input.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"data","via":"bytes"},{"on":4,"type":"control","via":"branch selection"}]},
  {"step":6,"file":"lib/asn1.c","function":"ptls_asn1_validation","line":287,"var":"decoded","code":"size_t decoded = ptls_asn1_validation_recursive(bytes, length, &decode_error, 0, log_ctx);","note":"Validation begins by recursively decoding the attacker-controlled buffer from offset 0.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"data","via":"bytes"}]},
  {"step":7,"file":"lib/asn1.c","function":"ptls_asn1_validation_recursive","line":219,"var":"byte_index","code":"ptls_asn1_read_type(bytes, bytes_max, &structure_bit, &type_class, &type_number, decode_error, level, log_ctx);","note":"The first byte is interpreted as ASN.1 type metadata, including the constructed bit and tag number.","depends_on":[{"on":6,"type":"data","via":"bytes[0]"}]},
  {"step":8,"file":"lib/asn1.c","function":"ptls_asn1_read_type","line":91,"var":"*type_number","code":"if (*type_number == 31) {","note":"A high-tag-number form triggers a loop that keeps reading continuation bytes from the same buffer.","depends_on":[{"on":7,"type":"data","via":"tag bits"}]},
  {"step":9,"file":"lib/asn1.c","function":"ptls_asn1_read_type","line":97,"var":"bytes[byte_index]","code":"while (byte_index < bytes_max && long_type <= type_number_limit) { next_byte = bytes[byte_index++]; ... }","note":"The loop advances byte_index while consuming continuation bytes; malformed or truncated encodings can leave the parser near the end of the buffer.","depends_on":[{"on":8,"type":"data","via":"long tag parsing"}]},
  {"step":10,"file":"lib/asn1.c","function":"ptls_asn1_validation_recursive","line":227,"var":"last_byte","code":"ptls_asn1_read_length(bytes, bytes_max, byte_index, &length, &indefinite_length, &last_byte, decode_error, level, log_ctx);","note":"The next byte sequence is decoded as a length field, which determines the recursive bounds for child elements.","depends_on":[{"on":7,"type":"data","via":"byte_index"}]},
  {"step":11,"file":"lib/asn1.c","function":"ptls_asn1_read_length","line":147,"var":"byte_index + length_of_length","code":"if (byte_index + length_of_length >= bytes_max) { ... *decode_error = PTLS_ERROR_BER_MALFORMED_LENGTH; }","note":"The vulnerable path is reached when the parser is driven into edge-case length encodings near the end of the buffer.","depends_on":[{"on":10,"type":"data","via":"length bytes"}]},
  {"step":12,"file":"lib/asn1.c","function":"ptls_asn1_validation_recursive","line":236,"var":"bytes[byte_index]","code":"while (byte_index < last_byte) { if (indefinite_length != 0 && bytes[byte_index] == 0) { ... } else { ... } }","note":"The recursive descent uses byte_index and last_byte as bounds, but the loop condition still permits a read of bytes[byte_index] at the current frontier.","depends_on":[{"on":10,"type":"data","via":"last_byte"},{"on":11,"type":"control","via":"error handling / malformed length"}]},
  {"step":13,"file":"lib/asn1.c","function":"ptls_asn1_validation_recursive","line":237,"var":"bytes[byte_index]","code":"if (indefinite_length != 0 && bytes[byte_index] == 0) {","note":"When the malformed ASN.1 structure drives recursion to the boundary, this direct byte read can step past the allocated heap object, causing the ASAN heap-buffer-overflow read.","depends_on":[{"on":12,"type":"data","via":"loop frontier"}]}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
